armorstudio.opt.enabled.desc: Master switch. When off, every player renders exactly like vanilla.
armorstudio.opt.quick_hide_self.desc: Quick toggle that hides your armor regardless of the profile (default key: H).
armorstudio.opt.notifications.desc: Short message when a profile changes or a quick toggle is used.
armorstudio.opt.inventory_preview.desc: Which armor the player model in the inventory screen shows.
armorstudio.opt.glint_strength.desc: Minecraft's accessibility option for the visibility of the enchantment glint.
armorstudio.opt.glint_speed.desc: Minecraft's accessibility option for the animation speed of the enchantment glint.
armorstudio.opt.show_piece.desc.helmet: Hidden helmets reveal your skin's head and hat layer.
armorstudio.opt.show_piece.desc.chestpla: Independent from the elytra (see Elytra & Equipment).
armorstudio.opt.show_piece.desc.leggings: Only the look changes; the leggings stay equipped.
armorstudio.opt.show_piece.desc.boots: Only the look changes; the boots stay equipped.
armorstudio.opt.head_items.desc: Carved pumpkins, mob heads, player heads and banners worn on the head.
armorstudio.opt.opacity.desc: 100% is fully visible, 0% hides the piece.
armorstudio.opt.color_enabled.desc: Recolors leather, tints every other material.
armorstudio.opt.color.desc: Pick a preset or drag the hue and shade bars.
armorstudio.opt.color_strength.desc: How strongly the custom color is applied.
armorstudio.opt.brightness.desc: Darkens the piece. 100% is the original brightness.
armorstudio.opt.glint.desc: Default follows the item; Hidden removes it; Always shows it even when not enchanted.
armorstudio.opt.trims.desc: Smithing trim patterns on this piece.
armorstudio.opt.elytra.desc: Managed independently from the chestplate setting.
armorstudio.opt.hud_enabled.desc: Shows your real equipment, even when it is hidden visually.
armorstudio.opt.hud_anchor.desc: Screen corner or edge the HUD is attached to.
armorstudio.opt.hud_offset_x.desc: Distance from the anchor towards the screen center.
armorstudio.opt.hud_offset_y.desc: Distance from the anchor towards the screen center.
armorstudio.opt.hud_text.desc: Percent, exact remaining points, both, or icons only.
armorstudio.opt.hud_color_text.desc: Uses the same green to red colors as the durability bar.
armorstudio.opt.hud_show_empty.desc: Keeps a placeholder for slots without armor.
armorstudio.opt.hud_hide_no_armor.desc: Hides the HUD completely when no armor is equipped.
armorstudio.opt.low_threshold.desc: Pieces at or below this durability are highlighted. Off disables warnings.
armorstudio.opt.low_blink.desc: Flashes the piece in the HUD.
armorstudio.opt.low_sound.desc: Plays a short sound once when a piece becomes low (only you hear it).
armorstudio.opt.low_message.desc: Shows a local message above the hotbar once when a piece becomes low.
armorstudio.opt.auto_enabled.desc: Switches profiles when you join worlds. Leaving restores your own choice.
armorstudio.opt.auto_multiplayer.desc: Profile used on servers without their own rule.
armorstudio.opt.server_rule.desc: Profile for this server. Choose None to remove the rule.
armorstudio.opt.translucency.desc: Smooth uses translucent rendering. Hide below 50% is a fallback for shaders.
armorstudio.action.hide_all.desc: Hides all four pieces. Your armor keeps protecting you.
armorstudio.action.apply_all.desc: Copies opacity, color, brightness, glint and trim settings to the other three pieces.
armorstudio.action.reset_piece.desc: Restores the default appearance of this piece (visibility is kept).
armorstudio.action.hud_editor.desc: Opens an editor where you can drag the HUD and scroll to resize it.
armorstudio.action.hud_reset_position.de: Moves the HUD back next to the hotbar.
armorstudio.action.import_clipboard.desc: Adds a profile from JSON in the clipboard (as created by Export).
armorstudio.action.restore_presets.desc: Re-adds built-in presets you deleted. Existing profiles are not changed.
armorstudio.action.bind_server_none: Join a server to add a rule
armorstudio.action.bind_server.desc: Always switches to the current profile when you join this server.
armorstudio.action.edit_keys.desc: Opens Minecraft's key binding screen (category "Armor Studio").
armorstudio.action.reload.desc: Re-reads armorstudio.json, for example after editing it by hand.
armorstudio.action.reset_all.desc: Restores all settings and profiles to their defaults.
armorstudio.mode.hide_mine.desc: Hides your armor; other players stay unchanged.
armorstudio.mode.hide_others.desc: Hides other players' armor on your screen; yours stays visible.
armorstudio.mode.others_no_helmet.desc: Shows all armor but hides other players' helmets so you can see their faces.
armorstudio.note.glint_global: These two sliders are Minecraft's own accessibility options and affect every enchanted item. Per-piece glint visibility is on the Armor Appearance page.
armorstudio.note.client_side: Armor Studio is purely visual and works only on your client. Your real equipment, armor points, enchantments and durability never change. Servers and other players do not need the mod, and nothing is sent to the server.
armorstudio.note.quick_hide_hint: Tip: press H (configurable) to hide all of your armor in an instant.
armorstudio.note.quick_hide_active: "Hide all of my armor" is on, so your pieces are hidden regardless of these switches.
armorstudio.note.visual_only: Hiding only changes how armor is drawn on your screen. The armor stays equipped and keeps protecting you.
armorstudio.note.others_local: Settings for other players only change what you see. They still see their own armor (and yours) unless they use Armor Studio themselves.
armorstudio.note.materials: Leather is recolored completely because its texture is grayscale. Other materials are tinted: the color multiplies the texture, so it can shift and darken colors but never make armor brighter than its texture.
armorstudio.note.translucency: Below 100% opacity the piece is drawn translucent. The glint is hidden on translucent pieces unless set to Always. If a shader pack shows translucent armor incorrectly, use "Hide below 50%" on the Compatibility page.
armorstudio.note.accessories: Elytra settings apply to the vanilla elytra (and modded wings that use the vanilla equipment system). Accessory slots from other mods (Curios, Trinkets, Accessories) are drawn by those mods and are not changed.
armorstudio.note.hud_real: The HUD always shows your real equipment, including pieces you have hidden visually.
armorstudio.note.profiles: Click a profile to select it for renaming. Export copies the profile to the clipboard and saves it to config/armorstudio/exports.
armorstudio.note.no_server_rules: No server rules yet. Join a server and use the button above.
armorstudio.note.keys: Armor Studio uses Minecraft's regular key binding system. A red key is also used by another binding.
armorstudio.compat.none: No known rendering or cosmetic mods detected.
armorstudio.compat.shaders: Smooth opacity uses the translucent armor render type. If translucent armor looks wrong with your shader pack, switch "Opacity rendering" to "Hide below 50%".
armorstudio.compat.sodium: Only changes terrain rendering; armor is drawn by Minecraft's entity renderer and is unaffected.
armorstudio.compat.skinlayers: Hidden armor reveals your 3D skin layers as usual.
armorstudio.compat.cosmetic_armor: Armor Studio styles whatever ends up on the rendered model. Hiding a slot in Armor Studio also hides the cosmetic item shown there.
armorstudio.compat.geckolib: Armor with custom models is hidden correctly. Color and opacity only apply to armor drawn by Minecraft's equipment renderer.
armorstudio.compat.accessories: Accessory slots are drawn by those mods and are not affected by Armor Studio.
armorstudio.compat.figura: Avatars that replace the player model may draw their own armor; Armor Studio only affects the vanilla armor layers.
armorstudio.compat.emf: Custom models and textures work as long as armor is drawn by the vanilla armor layer.
armorstudio.keys.toggle_self.desc: Hides or shows all of your own armor instantly.
armorstudio.keys.toggle_others.desc: Hides or shows other players' armor in the active profile.
armorstudio.keys.toggle_hud.desc: Shows or hides the armor HUD.
armorstudio.keys.toggle_mod.desc: Turns all Armor Studio changes on or off.
armorstudio.profiles.name: Profile name
armorstudio.profiles.row_hint: Click to select this profile for renaming.
armorstudio.preview.no_world: Join a world to see the live preview.
armorstudio.preview.help: Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom. "Samples" fills empty slots with example armor (preview only).
armorstudio.hud_editor.title: Armor HUD position
armorstudio.hud_editor.help: Drag the HUD, scroll to resize, arrow keys to nudge, Esc when done.

armorstudio.notify.delete_last: The last profile can not be deleted
